findings.defect: Stable-safe convergence asserts the straw was soaked even when the route only moves the stablehand or carries the lantern clear.
findings.routeWitness: stableYard.leadStablehandClear and stableYard.useLanternGuard both lead directly to stableSafe without a water/dousing action; stableSafe says the straw is soaked.
findings.violatedRule: Outcome narration must not claim an unperformed action or unsupported consequence.

findings.defect: Withdrawal from an active drowning emergency converges on a neutral recreation ending that erases the unresolved swimmer emergency.
findings.routeWitness: visitOutcome=drowningEmergency: sunnyBank.wadeIn -> shallows.swimOut -> firstSwim; firstSwim says {{swimmer}} is farther out and still calling for help. firstSwim.turnBackEarly and firstSwim.floatInPlace both lead to quietRest, whose text says the afternoon passed without a great event and records no unresolved victim state.
findings.violatedRule: A shared ending must preserve unresolved person/outcome state; withdrawal is not evidence that a danger was resolved.

findings.defect: Shared safe-landing text asserts ferry-crew participation on successful self-guided rescues that never signal or meet the crew.
findings.routeWitness: callBoatOwner -> downstreamBank.walkBankToShelf(success) -> safeLanding; enterCurrent(success) -> barWithMyrna.walkTongueTogether(success) -> safeLanding. Neither route establishes ferry crew presence, while safeLanding says the crew checks the line.
findings.violatedRule: Optional participant involvement may be narrated only when the route establishes it.

findings.defect: Source-specific shared wrongSource text claims prior well closure/cleanup on a branch that only set the barrel aside.
findings.routeWitness: barrelInspection.coverBarrel -> barrelSetAside -> barrelWasNotCauseWell or barrelWasNotCauseDebris -> wrongSource. The preceding effects set barrelClosed only; wrongSource variants claim the well was closed, with wellDebris text also claiming its channel is being cleared.
findings.violatedRule: Investigation and containment state in converged text must match actions actually taken on the selected route.

clusters.name: Route-specific state lost at convergence
clusters.description: Route-specific location, outcome, person/helper, object, method, or prior-intervention facts are lost at convergence, causing shared scenes/endings to assert facts not established by every incoming route.

clusters.name: Knowledge/History without route proof
clusters.description: Knowledge and/or History is granted without sufficient route proof that the Traveler actually learned or established it.

clusters.name: Elapsed-time proxy used as event proof
clusters.description: Elapsed time is used as a proxy for a specific event/consequence, making later narration claim that event on routes where it did not occur.
